title: Core: phase/feature statusLog tracking
summary: Add statusLog to Phase + Feature schemas; append-on-change in PlanStore rollup.
description:
Persist status transition history for phases and features (currently status is derived-only, no history).

CURRENT STATE:
- `PhaseSchema` (packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts:~209) and `FeatureSchema` (~258) have NO `status` field (intentionally derived) and NO `statusLog`.
- `TaskSchema` has `statusLog: StatusLogEntry[]` (schema.ts:146) with `StatusLogEntrySchema` (id, date, fromStatus, toStatus, title, description).
- Status derivation lives in PlanStore: `syncStatuses` / `derivePhaseStatus` / `deriveFeatureStatus` (packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts) compute phase/feature status from child task statuses at read time.
- `Task` statusLog entries are appended by adapters when task status changes (task_start/task_complete/task_update with motivation).

WORK:
1. Add `statusLog: z.array(StatusLogEntrySchema).default([])` to `PhaseSchema` and `FeatureSchema`.
2. In PlanStore, wherever phase/feature derived status is recomputed (syncStatuses rollup), compare the new derived status to the LAST `statusLog` entry's `toStatus` (treat empty as "planned"); if different, append a new `StatusLogEntry` { id, date: now, fromStatus: lastOrPlanned, toStatus: new, title: `${from} → ${to}`, description: "" }. Do NOT persist a `status` field — `status` stays derived; `statusLog` is an audit trail only.
3. Append-on-change only (compare last entry's toStatus) to avoid duplicate entries on every read.
4. Export the updated types; ensure `Phase`/`Feature` runtime types still re-add the derived `status` field (already do).
5. Add a migration helper to backfill empty `statusLog` for existing phases/features (no-op if already present; optionally seed a single "planned" entry from createdAt for phases with no transitions — but simplest: leave empty, stepper treats empty as "planned → current").

EDGE CASES: re-derivation must be idempotent (no duplicate entries on repeated reads of the same state); phase with no tasks → stays "planned", no entries; feature with no phases → same.

BEHAVIORS TO PRESERVE: `status` remains derived/unpersisted; existing `Task.statusLog` untouched; PlanStore API signatures stable.
